sampleSizeRationale: The frozen eligible corpus contains six repair tasks and two negative controls from seven public repositories. Each of the four requested model configurations receives six paired repair tasks and two paired controls across three workflows, producing 96 assignments. The primary pooled estimand is an equal-weight average across exactly those four configurations; every configuration is also reported separately. Repository-clustered resampling keeps all configurations paired within each task. This corrected scanner-enriched batch estimates effects only for the registered SiteCMD-detected cases. Seven repository clusters and six repairs per configuration provide descriptive uncertainty, not a broad superiority-powered claim; the full fixed batch is reported without optional stopping.

analysis.population: Public repositories meeting the frozen source limits and exact corrected SiteCMD scanner-eligibility rules in the v2 scanner-enriched selection frame
